name: Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental, Abu Dhabi
positioning: Beachfront palace hotel on the West Corniche Road in Abu Dhabi, with a private beach and a wide choice of restaurants
best_for: Travelers who want a private-beach stay in Abu Dhabi
Food lovers who want many restaurants on site

facts.text: Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental is located on a pristine private beach.
The hotel is located on the West Corniche Road in the Ras Al Akhdar district of Abu Dhabi.
The resort is positioned along a 1.3-kilometer private beachfront.
The hotel offers dining across 12 venues.
Talea by Antonio Guida is a one Michelin-starred restaurant serving authentic Italian cuisine.
Hakkasan is a one Michelin-starred restaurant serving authentic Cantonese cuisine.
Guests can enjoy 24-hour access to two state-of-the-art gyms.
The Spa's signature experiences include Moroccan-inspired hammam therapies.
The Family Deluxe Sea View room has interconnecting king and twin beds.

highlights.text: The Deluxe Sea View Room has breathtaking views of The Gulf from a private balcony.
The Beachfront Suite comes with dedicated 24-hour butler service.
The Club Sea View Room includes EP Club access with complimentary daily champagne breakfast.
Strawfire by Ross Shonhan is a Japanese restaurant described as an immersive celebration of Japanese warayaki.
Guests can enjoy beachfront padel and tennis courts.

considerations.text: Guests are encouraged to secure restaurant reservations in advance.
The minimum age requirement for access to the spa is 16 years of age.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing reflecting the premium positioning.
WhataHotel notes a formal atmosphere that may not suit casual travelers.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
